sources_used.source: Exa Places place-detail pages (fetched directly - names, addresses, phones, websites, review recency)
BestProsInTown city directories (South Brunswick, Dayton, Kendall Park, Monmouth Junction, spa category)
GymsNJ South Brunswick directory + individual business pages
Loc8NearMe South Brunswick index + individual listings
WebMD provider directories (chiropractor, Dayton; Kendall Park)
National Chiropractors Association / chirohub / WhereOrg chiropractic directories
Web search (Exa-backed place lists + OpenAI-backed category/town answers)

categories_thin: Med spas / aesthetics: only one directory-confirmed med spa inside the zone (Renatus Aesthetics); most results were in Plainsboro, Princeton, North Brunswick or East Brunswick, outside the zone.

Mental health / counseling: national platforms (Lifebulb, Ellie Mental Health - a franchise) dominate search results; remaining local listings are mostly solo therapists working from residential addresses, which are out of scope. Only one named group practice confirmed (Awakened Path).

Dental specialists (endodontics, periodontics, oral surgery, pediatric dentistry): none confirmed with a South Brunswick street address - the specialists surfaced were in East Brunswick, North Brunswick or Princeton.

Dermatology, OB/GYN, ENT, cardiology, orthopedics and pain management: nearly all local results are large health-system practices (Penn Medicine, Hackensack Meridian, RWJBarnabas) which the brief excludes; only small independent practices were captured.
Optometry: two of three candidates found were outside the zone (Franklin Park, Jamesburg); only Executive Eye Associates and Lens & Frames confirmed inside.
Pet grooming/boarding: most groomers found are mobile-only businesses based elsewhere (East Brunswick, Middlesex County) with no South Brunswick address.
Audiologists / hearing aids: none found with a South Brunswick address; the nearest independent practices are in East Brunswick and New Brunswick.
caveats: Google Maps and Bing Maps returned only 5-7 local results per query in this environment (limited anonymous view), so map coverage is a sample rather than a full enumeration.

Yellow Pages, BBB, Manta, ChamberofCommerce.com, Cylex, Opendi, LocalityBiz and guide.in.ua all returned HTTP 403 / Cloudflare blocks, so those bulk directories could not be mined directly; several businesses appear only via a search snippet of those sites.
The Overpass / OpenStreetMap API was unreachable from this environment; no OSM extract was used.

Exa Places detail pages were the single richest source (name, address, phone, website, review recency) and were opened directly; ratings and 'open' status there reflect recent crawls, not a live check.
Several entries are directory-only (one bulk listing) and are flagged in active_evidence; the triage team should confirm they still operate before outreach.

Solo practitioners working from residential addresses were deliberately excluded to stay within business-contact-only rules (e.g. a Reiki practitioner on Hastings Rd, a makeup artist on Libby Drive, a chiropractor on Talia Rd). The real count of independent health/wellness practices in the zone is higher than listed.

Franchise and chain locations were excluded, including MassageLuXe Kendall Park, Hair Cuttery Dayton, Supercuts Monmouth Junction, The Smilist Dental Dayton, Twin Boro Physical Therapy, The MAX Challenge / MAX Fitness & Wellness Center South Brunswick, Ellie Mental Health, Lifebulb Counseling, Club Pilates, F45 and Crunch.
The MAX Fitness & Wellness Center at 3790 US-1 shares its phone number with The MAX Challenge South Brunswick franchise page and was therefore treated as a franchise location and dropped.
Nearly all addresses in this zone fall within 10 miles of central Milltown; no part of South Brunswick falls outside the radius.
data_gaps: No official South Brunswick Township business directory or licensed-business list was retrievable; the township website did not load from this environment and southbrunswicknj.gov has no public business directory found.

Route 27 and Route 1 strip-mall tenants (nail salons, threading/waxing, small salons) are numerous but many have no web presence and appear only in blocked directories - likely undercounted by 15-30 businesses.
Some listings could not be resolved to a street address (Chetna Beauty Salon, The Nail Spa, B2Z Dance School, Vriksham Bharathanatyam, Maya Reuven DO, New Body Boot Camp) and are marked Unknown.
No chiropractor, salon or dental practices in the southern Route 130 / Dayton industrial corridor were separately enumerated beyond those listed.
A full psychology-today/Psychology Today sweep of individual therapists was not attempted; group practices only were captured.
